description: Searches awarded US federal contracts on USAspending.gov by agency, keyword and dollar amount, largest first. Recompete mode instead lists contracts expiring soonest within a window (set min_amount to keep the search narrow), with the incumbent and days until expiry. Every record links to the official award page.

agency.description: Awarding top-tier agency name. Several names separated by a semicolon.

award_types.description: Codes separated by commas, from one group (contracts A,B,C,D by default; 02 to 11 are grants and loans).

expiring_after_days.description: Recompete mode: skip contracts ending sooner than this, for bid lead time. Default 0.

expiring_within_days.description: Recompete mode: contracts ending within this many days, 1 to 1825. Default 365.

keyword.description: Free text across award descriptions and recipient names. Up to 500 characters.

min_amount.description: Only awards at or above this many dollars. Recompete mode usually needs this, or an agency or keyword, to be narrow enough.

mode.description: search lists awards, largest first; recompete lists contracts about to expire, soonest first. Defaults to recompete when an expiring_ field is set.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, awards with activity from this date. Default 2024-10-01 (the past year in recompete mode). Not before 2007-10-01.

name: federal_contracts
title: Federal contract awards and recompetes
